svg.title: LD01 delta-expert data structure
svg.desc: Sixteen rank-4 experts live in A_all (16 by 64) and B_all (64 by 16); a token's 16-entry gate is expanded to 64 entries by a constant block one-hot so the routed sum over all experts is x times A_all, scaled, times B_all; the table compares bytes per expert with full experts.
svg.text: LD01 DELTA EXPERTS -- sixteen experts in two matrices
WHAT: expert e is x @ A_e @ B_e with A_e [16,4], B_e [4,16]; all sixteen are column blocks of A_all and row blocks of B_all
A_all [16, 64] after training (|value|, brighter = larger); columns 4e..4e+3 belong to expert e
B_all transposed [16, 64] (rows of B_all are the same expert blocks)
expand [16, 64]: gate value of expert e repeated 4 times (block one-hot)
WHY: a full expert costs 1,072 parameters and a rank-4 delta 128, so sixteen fit in the budget of two; the shared FFN keeps the nonlinearity.
HOW: u:delta_out = matmul(matmul(x, A_all) * matmul(gate, expand), B_all) with u:delta_expand's constant; parity is tested.
